IWVPL CHAMPIONS LEAGUE SEASON 1 – Team Registration
Step onto the ultimate virtual pitch and clash with the elite in the IWVPL Champions League Season 1! This is a high-stakes arena where individual skill and tactical mastery will be pushed to the limit.
Tournament Format & System:
  • 1v1 Tactical Battles: Every match is an intense One-versus-One (1v1) showdown. Prove your individual mastery against the best players in the community.
  • Double Knockout Format: The competition runs on a thrilling Double-Elimination tournament system.
    • Upper Bracket: Keep your winning streak alive to secure a fast track to the Grand Final.
    • Lower Bracket: A single loss isn’t the end! Defeated teams from the Upper Bracket will drop to the Lower Bracket, giving you a second chance to fight your way back to the top. Two losses equal elimination.
Team & Roster Rules:
  • Max 2 Players Per Team: One (1) purchase is valid for one team entry. Each team is strictly limited to a maximum of 2 players (e.g., 1 Main Player and 1 Substitute). You have the flexibility to rotate who plays in each 1v1 match throughout the tournament.
⚠️ IMPORTANT CONFIRMATION NOTE:
Your purchase does not immediately finalize your tournament registration. Please allow 24 to 48 hours for our administration team to verify and process your entry. You will receive a final confirmation email containing your official team submission forms. Your entry status remains pending until this confirmation is received and your 2-player team roster is successfully submitted.
Ready to conquer Europe? Complete your purchase now to secure your spot!
